name: Shadows on the Grey Road

text.short: Travelers are vanishing along the Grey Road, and the cause is not yet clear.
text.summary: Investigate the disappearances along the Grey Road and decide how deeply to confront what lies behind them.
text.full: Travelers are vanishing or being attacked along the Grey Road near Dunmere. Bandits are part of the problem, but the pattern keeps failing to stay ordinary for long.
text.recap: You investigated the disappearances and violence surrounding the Grey Road.

discovery_summary: The Grey Road is unsafe, and Dunmere needs answers before fear hardens into the wrong kind of certainty.

text.short: Examine the broken caravan on the road.
text.summary: Study the recent caravan attack and determine what kind of violence happened there.
text.full: Examine the broken caravan closely enough to separate obvious violence from the details that make the scene wrong: the axle, the cargo, the missing travelers, and the tracks leaving the road.

text.short: Speak with travelers and villagers about the attacks.
text.summary: Talk to the people most affected by the road and compare their accounts.
text.full: Speak with the innkeeper, the survivor, and the villagers of Dunmere to understand how the attacks differ from ordinary bandit violence.

text.short: Track the suspicious movement beyond Dunmere.
text.summary: Use the local leads to locate the source of the road's instability.
text.full: Use the local leads and physical evidence to follow the movement beyond Dunmere, through the old forest path, and toward the ruined shrine where the attacks seem to gather.

text.short: Determine what is actually shaping the violence.
text.summary: Separate the surface threat from the deeper cause beneath it.
text.full: Study the shrine and what lies beneath it until the difference between surface bandit violence and the deeper influence becomes impossible to ignore.

text.short: Confront the source of the danger.
text.summary: Resolve the danger at the shrine and whatever lies beneath it.
text.full: Decide how to resolve the threat shaping the Grey Road, knowing the immediate answer and the true answer may not be the same.
